game_concept: A strategy race set in Snowy Hold – Snowdrift Barracks, barracks half buried in snow: the firewood keeper must handle winter bandits while practicing functions. Core idea – Return Vault: Use return to send a computed value back to the caller and open the beacon fire.
theme: Snowy Hold – Snowdrift Barracks: barracks half buried in snow
core_gameplay_loop: In Snowdrift Barracks, repeat each round: Use return to send a computed value back to the caller and open the beacon fire. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the firewood keeper ahead. Then check the vault value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the beacon fire by solving code steps involving vault that move the firewood keeper forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.7).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the beacon fire first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 5 (applied tier): Return Vault
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Return Vault' (Week 6 slot 3), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Snowdrift Barracks'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how vault changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against winter bandits in Snowdrift Barracks.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.7).
